heading: Preference for certain projects

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: In the consideration of applications submitted under section 12655b of this title, the Corporation shall give preference to programs that—

children.text: will provide long-term benefits to the public;
will instill a work ethic and a sense of public service in the participants;
will be labor intensive, and involve youth operating in crews;
can be planned and initiated promptly; and
will enhance skills development and educational level and opportunities for the participants.

tree.heading: Special rule
tree.text: In the consideration of applications under this division the Corporation shall ensure the equitable treatment of both urban and rural areas.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 12549 of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 103–82, § 101(a).

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 199H of Pub. L. 101–610 was classified to section 12655g of this title prior to repeal by Pub. L. 103–82, § 101(e)(8)(A).

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1993—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 103–82, § 101(e)(1), (7), in introductory provisions, substituted “Corporation” for “Commission” and “section 12655b” for “section 12543”. Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 103–82, § 101(e)(1), substituted “Corporation” for “Commission”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1993 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 103–82 effective Oct. 1, 1993, see section 123 of Pub. L. 103–82, set out as a note under section 1701 of Title 16, Conservation.
